plan.notes: Source: Agora University 2025-2026 Catalog (official PDF), section 47.2.1.2 Bachelor of Arts in Integrative Studies degree completion: required core WRIT 300 (Study & Writing Skills); Education Concentration concentration = the four catalog-listed courses (12 credits); 42 credits of general education in the seven catalog areas (12.9.1.1) modeled as 6-credit transfer slots; remaining credits are named BAIS electives (catalog 47.2.1.2.6) and advisor-approved general electives = 120 credits total. CATALOG CREDIT NOTE: the BAIS course listings give no per-course credit values; all BAIS courses are modeled at 3 credits, consistent with every other undergraduate course in the catalog. CATALOG CONSISTENCY NOTE: course code CIVL 310 appears twice with different titles ('Medicine in the Ancient World' and 'Myths of Mesopotamia & the Near East'); it is excluded from this plan pending registrar clarification. Course titles hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Agora University is a fully online institution; the catalog gives no fixed semester map, so this plan models a self-paced 8-term sequence a degree-completion student could follow. All courses are 3-credit units per the catalog. Degree-completion students must complete at least 30% of the 120 credits at Agora; up to 70% may transfer.
